languageLoadError: Could not load the language. Please try again.
languageSaveError: The language changed on this device, but could not be saved to your account.
languageDraft: Additional interface languages are translation drafts awaiting human review.
translateConsent: I agree to send this message's text to Google for translation.
translatePrivacy: Prefer on-device translation; otherwise send only this message to Google, up to 5000 characters, without images, attachments or quoted history. The original is kept.
translateExternalPrivacy: For external email, only its plain-text body is sent, up to 5,000 characters. Images and attachments are not sent.
translateTruncated: Only the first 5,000 characters were translated.
translateNotEnabled: Google Translate has not been enabled by the administrator.
translateKeyHint: Leave blank to keep the saved key. The key is never sent to visitors.
translateSiteLimit: Daily characters for the whole site
translateSetupHint: Enable Cloud Translation API (Basic v2) in Google Cloud, configure billing and API restrictions, then save the key here. Translation may incur Google charges. Daily quotas reset at 00:00 UTC.
translateErrorDisabled: Google Translate is not configured or is disabled.
translateErrorEmpty: This message has no text to translate.
translateErrorUnavailable: This message is no longer available.
translateErrorQuota: The translation usage limit has been reached. Please try again later.
translateErrorProvider: Google could not translate the message. Please try again later.
translateErrorKey: Google rejected the configured key. Ask the administrator to check API and billing settings.
translateErrorTimeout: Google Translate timed out. Please try again.
translateErrorBinding: The translation quota service is unavailable.
translateErrorConfig: Check the API key and translation limits.
serviceUnavailable: The service is temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.
translateAutoConsent: Prefer installed on-device browser translation models. When unavailable, send visible incoming message text to Google. Up to 5000 characters per message; no images, attachments or quoted chat history. Originals are kept; preferences are saved in this browser.
deleteSelfConfirm: Remove this message from your account only? The other participant keeps their copy.
stickersError: Cannot load this pack. Check the link or the platform Telegram bot configuration.
translateTestHint: Save changes first. This test uses the saved key to translate only “Hello”, never chat messages. It counts toward translation quotas and may incur Google charges.
translateErrorBilling: Google Cloud billing is disabled or unavailable for this project.
translateErrorApiDisabled: Enable Cloud Translation API (Basic v2) in the Google Cloud project that owns this key.
translateErrorRestriction: API key restrictions blocked this server request. Check API and application restrictions in Google Cloud.
translateErrorNetwork: The server could not connect to Google Translation. Check network access and try again.
contactUsernameHint: Unique username: 3–24 letters, digits or underscores, starting with a letter; case-insensitive. Setting it makes you searchable. Save empty to remove.
contactRemarkHint: Only you can see this note. Up to 50 characters; save empty to clear.
contactNotFound: No user found. Check that they have set a username.
roomEmpty: Choose or create a group or channel
roomChannelReadOnly: Only owners and administrators can publish to this channel.
roomInviteHint: Invite by site username. After accepting, members can view message history.
roomDeleteConfirm: Delete this group or channel and all its messages permanently?
roomRemoveConfirm: Remove this member? They will lose access to messages.
roomLimit: The group, channel or membership limit has been reached.
roomOwnerLeave: Owners cannot leave their own group or channel.
voiceUnavailable: This browser does not support voice input. Use your system keyboard dictation instead.
voicePrivacy: Recognition is provided by your browser; audio may be sent to its speech service. Text is inserted into your draft for you to review and send manually.
voiceDenied: Cannot use the microphone. Check the device and browser/system microphone permissions.
voiceError: Speech recognition failed. Retry or use system keyboard dictation.
videoUnsupported: This format or codec cannot play directly. Try compatible playback.
videoConvertFailed: This device could not prepare the video. Download the original to play it.
videoTooLarge: Compatible playback supports videos up to 10 MB.
videoBusy: Another video is being processed. Try again shortly.
videoLoadFailed: Could not load this video. Retry or download the original.
fileDropHint: Up to 10 files, 10 MB total. Dropping adds attachments without sending them.
chatSelectionLimit: Select up to 100 messages at a time.
roomSearchLoaded: Searches loaded messages. Load earlier messages to include more history.
omniHint: Search usernames, email addresses, remarks, message text or filenames. Usernames require at least 3 characters.
voiceRecordingHint: Up to 2 minutes / 5 MB. Review the recording, then add it to your draft and send manually.
voiceCloudPrivacy: This audio will be sent to Cloudflare AI for transcription. Transcription uses the site’s AI quota; the audio is not retained by this feature.
voiceRecordUnavailable: Recording is unavailable. Use HTTPS and a browser that supports microphone recording.
voiceAudioLimit: Use a supported audio file of no more than 5 MB.
voiceQuota: Daily transcription limit reached. Try again tomorrow.
voiceTranscribeError: Transcription is unavailable. Check the AI binding or quota, or try again later.
stickersImportHint: Paste a Telegram pack link or name. Supports addstickers and addemoji.
stickersPublicPreview: Imported the static previews available on the public page. Full animated packs need a valid site Telegram bot.
stickersErrorLink: Use t.me/addstickers/name, t.me/addemoji/name or a pack name.
stickersErrorConfig: The site needs a valid Telegram bot to import complete packs.
stickersErrorAuth: The Telegram bot token is invalid or revoked. Ask the administrator to update it, or upload local stickers.
stickersErrorNotFound: Sticker pack not found. Check the name and whether the pack is still public.
stickersErrorNetwork: Cannot reach Telegram. Retry or upload local stickers.
stickersErrorEmpty: This pack has no importable stickers.
stickersErrorPublic: No readable previews on the public page. Ask the administrator to configure a bot, or upload local stickers.
appInstallDescription: Open your mailbox in its own app window, with quick access to chats and email.
appInstallIosAdd: Choose “Add to Home Screen”, then tap “Add”.
appInstallIosFallback: If “Add to Home Screen” is missing, open this site in Safari.
appInstallAndroid: Open the browser menu, choose “Install app” or “Add to Home Screen”, and confirm.
appInstallMac: In a supported Safari version, choose File → Add to Dock, then confirm.
appInstallDesktop: In Chrome or Edge, click the install icon in the address bar, or choose “Install this page as an app” from the browser menu.
appInstallAvailability: Installation depends on browser support. If no install option is available, try a current Chrome or Edge version.
pushIntro: Enable this device for background system notifications. Preview, message categories and mutes sync across your account; enabling or disabling this device affects only this device.
pushDeviceEnabled: Background notifications enabled on this device
pushError: Notification settings or delivery are unavailable. Try again later.
pushUnsupported: Background push is unavailable in this browser. Use current Chrome or Edge, or open the installed Home Screen app on iPhone.
pushDenied: Notifications were not allowed. Enable them in browser or system site settings and retry.
pushIosInstall: On iPhone/iPad, add this site to the Home Screen, then open its app icon to enable notifications.
pushDeviceLimit: The five-device limit was reached. Disable notifications on an unused device.
pushLimits: iPhone/iPad requires iOS/iPadOS 16.4 or later. Delivery depends on system power settings, browser and network. Lock-screen previews also follow system settings.
browserNotice: Content comes from the original website. If blank, blocked or unable to sign in, open externally.
browserSlow: This site is slow or may block embedding. Keep waiting or open externally.
browserHttp: This link uses HTTP. Open it externally.
browserPreviewUnavailable: No page summary available. Open the page to view it.
